summary.text: Michael Howe is the Republican incumbent Secretary of State, a former state legislator first elected in 2022. In a July 2026 interview he said North Dakota's elections are secure, pointing to proof-of-citizenship checks at ID issuance, paper ballots and encrypted result reporting.

paragraphs.text: Howe is a fifth-generation farmer who helps run his family's seed farm near Casselton, and he graduated from North Dakota State University in 2010.
He worked in Washington, D.C., as agriculture policy director for Rep. Rick Berg.
Howe later served as a state representative for District 22.
He has been North Dakota's secretary of state since January 1, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
